column1: # Which CI shard of scripts/gates-have-teeth.sh runs which case.
# Columns, tab separated: shard, seconds, case name. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The seconds are what the case (and the baseline it needed) took in CI; the shards were
# filled longest case first so each carries about the same. Regenerate from the logs of a
# CI run with: python3 scripts/teeth-rebalance.py LOG... > scripts/teeth-shards.tsv
# A case this file does not name runs in the shard its position gives it, so adding a
# case needs no edit here; scripts/teeth-shards-cover-every-case.sh checks the result.
